title: Any jostling tips this over and dumps everything off
text:
Any jostling tips this over and dumps everything off. At first glance, this looks like a great idea. It's more of a half finished idea that just almost works properly. It's easy to assemble and arrange the little brackets in whatever configuration you want. The caddy is also weighs next to nothing.

I was able to stack six different items on it including tin foil, different sizes of freezer bags and that plastic wrap. All of the various sizes and box shapes were accommodated by the hooks. However, every time we tried to remove an item to use, the entire caddy tips over. Picking it up to move to a different location was just a mess - everything slides off. I think I was better off just leaving our stuff in an extra drawer.
